9. Voice: explainer clips for the 10 standard slides baked ONCE and cached (the bake queue has a backlog + flaky fetches tonight — the ceremony is text-first by design, voice ignites where baked; voice failure never blocks a slide).
10. The Hub top-3 sidebar: staging-first on the monolith; byte-careful harvest edit (existing sidebar component, fed the citizen's three from their claimed identity); production only on a clean render proof — else it follows as the first seam fix, with tabs carrying tonight's landing.

**THE HANDSHAKE (acceptance, both paths, from the citizen's seat):** a cold seat creates an account BY VOICE ONLY → certificate → presentation → reveal shows three covered pages at the packet defaults → pages live at their addresses, filled, private one REFUSES a second identity, mail round-trips from the page, first matches carry reasons → different seat + different login verifies and scorecards. Anything less is a progress report, not a launch.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The distance between "designed" and "live" was never invention — it was assembly. Tonight the pieces stop being a parts bin and become a place a person can arrive at. And the settings law makes the arrival safe to love: your world, your switches, sensible defaults, enforced by the machine — not by promises.

notes.title: Two Paths, One System — The Interface Path and the Engine Path
notes.subtitle: Shawn's bottom line (2026-10-24): all of tonight's definitions exist to get this LOCKED IN and DONE RIGHT — and the work runs on **two paths that work together**. **The Interface Path** (Nitro's…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn's bottom line (2026-10-24): all of tonight's definitions exist to get this LOCKED IN and DONE RIGHT — and the work runs on **two paths that work together**. **The Interface Path** (Nitro's side, with Tree — the Interfaces/Hub seat): everything the citizen sees, touches, and feels — the ceremony, the pages, the covers, the personal Hub, the offer words. **The Engine Path** (the rest of the team): everything that makes it true — the governed core, identity and authority, the matching engine, mail routing, the activation machinery, the doors, the evidence. Neither path is the product alone: a beautiful interface over an unproven engine is a lie, and a proven engine behind a cold interface is a warehouse. **They meet at one seam — the capability contract:** every element the interface shows binds to a named engine capability carrying a state (specified · implemented · tested · live-verified · production-proven, per #3028). The interface never promises past the engine's proof; the engine builds in the order the interface's journeys demand. And the handshake is the JOURNEY TEST: a journey counts only when both paths pass it together, end to end, from the citizen's seat.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: **For anyone joining the work, the map is one picture:** the citizen walks the Interface Path — claim, certificate, presentation, world, personal Hub (SN-0849). Under every step, the Engine Path answers — identity issued, pages derived, covers composed, matches computed, mail routed, evidence written (SN-0850). When a step feels magical, both paths did their half. When something is missing, the map says whose half it is — no fog, no finger-pointing: interface gaps look like *the citizen can't see it, reach it, or understand it*; engine gaps look like *it isn't true, isn't proven, or isn't running*. The Official Welcome is the first journey both paths walk together, and its acceptance test is the handshake: cold activation, voice only, landing in a personal Hub — interface beautiful, engine true, at the same time.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: One team builds the house you can see — the doors, the paint, the welcome mat. The other team builds the plumbing and the lights inside the walls. You only get a real house when both teams finish the same house, and you check it by living in it for a day, not by admiring the paint or the pipes alone.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's like a restaurant: the dining room and the kitchen are two paths, one meal. The menu may only promise what the kitchen can actually cook, and the kitchen cooks what the menu's guests actually order. You judge the place by the meal arriving — hot, right, and as described.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body:
**Ownership, plainly:** Interface Path — Nitro (lead) + Tree (Interfaces/Hub) · the ceremony (SN-0846/0849), Trinity pages and covers, Hub personalization (sidebar top-3, tabs), the offer surface (SN-0847 words, gated by states). Engine Path — the seats on #3028/#3029 and the core lanes: the governed core + doors (SN-0850), the Smart Match engine (SN-0845 — ONE shared engine), mail/identity routing, the five-part Power activation, proof + measurement machinery (Production Engine, SN-0844). Gates both paths answer to: Delta (LAW) on the contract, Epsilon (VERIFY) on the proof — different seats, different logins, per the standing law.
**The seam discipline (how the paths stay together):** (1) No interface element ships pointing at a capability below *implemented*; no public word promises below *live-verified*. (2) The engine's build order is set by the interface's journey order — the Welcome journey first, because that is where citizens arrive. (3) Every defect is filed as interface, engine, or seam — and seam defects (beautiful but untrue, true but unreachable) outrank both. (4) The scorecard loop (SN-0843's six dimensions) already measures the split: Human/Naya experience scores the interface path; execution, network intelligence, and trust score the engine path; a journey is 10 only when both are.
**It doesn't have to be this split forever** — Shawn's own words: the paths work together, and the split exists only to make the work clear. Seats may cross; the seam may not blur.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Clarity is the accelerator. Two paths, one seam, one test — every seat can now point at the map and know their half, their partner, and the exact moment the two halves become one true thing in a citizen's hands. That is how this gets done, and done right.

notes.title: The Operating Contract — One Brain, Many Doors
notes.subtitle: The governing rule, locked (Shawn's review, 2026-10-24; architecture recorded in Issue #3029, boundary in Issue #3028, the tier rule in SN-0848): **one network, one governed intelligence core, many…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: The governing rule, locked (Shawn's review, 2026-10-24; architecture recorded in Issue #3029, boundary in Issue #3028, the tier rule in SN-0848): **one network, one governed intelligence core, many authorized doors, two clearly differentiated experiences.** NayaNET is the network — Personal Worlds, Business Pages, Spaces, Connections, the collective intelligence. NayaPOWER is the one governed core behind it — identity, authority, canonical operations, memory, evidence, learning. The doors — Hub · MCP · REST/API · GitHub App · SDK · Webhooks · A2A — are doors into the SAME brain, never separate brains: a Naya arriving through any door reaches the same capabilities, respects the same permissions, and leaves the same evidence. **No Naya needs her own fork to participate** — agents and citizens use the shared, governed capabilities through the doors. A fork is something else entirely, and this contract states it precisely: **a fork is a copy of the code — it does not, by itself, create a running personal NayaPOWER node.** Personal activation = fork + deployment/activation + owner binding + isolated private state + verification. Each of those five is real work, and none may be skipped or implied.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
**What this means for a person:** you never need to copy or run anything to belong — claim your name and the network's doors are open to you (SN-0847's gift). If you later want your OWN NayaPOWER — your personal intelligence layer, running for you — that is an activation, not a download: your copy, brought to life, bound to you, your private state isolated from everyone else's, and verified working before anyone calls it on. **The offer, in its candidate words: "Your world. Your intelligence. Your network."** — start with a personal world already taking shape around you; discover the knowledge, people, projects, and communities that matter to you; and when you want your own Naya to do more, connect NayaPOWER and unlock memory, learning, authorized actions, reports, and automation — **as each capability becomes available and is verified.** The final public offer may contain only capabilities that pass their release tests (#3028); the words never run ahead of the proof.

**The honest economics:** the goal is near-zero MARGINAL cost — one more citizen, one more match, one more page should cost nearly nothing, because matching and organizing are deterministic math on shared machinery (event-driven, cached, no unnecessary AI calls). It is NOT zero total cost, and we never promise that: hosting, storage, security, messaging, and optional model inference are real costs the network carries. Near-zero at the margin, honest in total — that is the economics of the contract, measured per successful outcome (build sequence step 6).

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: There's one big library with one wise librarian-brain, and lots of doors into it — the front door, the side door, a door for helpers. Whichever door you walk through, it's the same library and the same rules. You never have to build your own library to read the books. If one day you want your OWN librarian who only works for you, we don't just hand you a photocopy of the library — we help you set her up properly, in your own house, with your own private notebooks locked away from everyone else's, and we check she works before we say she's yours.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Think of a bank. One bank, many ways in — the branch, the phone, the app — but it's always the same account and the same rules; nobody needs to found their own bank to have an account. And if someone wants a private vault of their own, a photocopy of the bank's rulebook isn't a vault: it has to be built, assigned to them, locked to them alone, and inspected. That's the difference between a fork and an activation.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body:
**Reconciliation with tonight's filings (nothing here contradicts them; two precisions are adopted):**
1. **Fork ≠ activation (adopted precision).** SN-0848 described the citizen's fork as home base via the Get Started flow (fork → activate with your AI → Connect GitHub). #3029 sharpens the middle step into its five real parts — deployment, owner binding, isolated private state, verification — and the two-owner isolation journey remains UNPROVEN in the documented status. The Official Welcome (SN-0849) proves the GIFT journey; the Power activation journey is its own proof program (sequence step 5: two independent test owners, isolation + persistence + retrieval + permissions + revocation).
2. **Doors converge with seats.** Tonight's seats/lanes through the GitHub App door ARE this architecture in operation: many Nayas, one repo, one governed core, consistent evidence. The contract generalizes it: every door (Hub, MCP, API, App, SDK, webhooks, A2A) must reach the same canonical operations under the same authority — a capability that exists in one door but not the governed core is a defect, not a feature.
3. **Build sequence (adopted as the order of work; mapped to live programs):** (1) establish the truth — capability inventory by state (#3028's audit) · (2) prove the free experience — **this is The Official Welcome, the #1 project (SN-0849)**: enter, complete or skip, populated starter world, verified public intelligence · (3) the shared intelligence doors — authorized Nayas on canonical services, no individual forks · (4) Smart Match — ONE shared explainable engine (SN-0845), never a per-room algorithm · (5) personal NayaPOWER activation — the five-part activation, two-owner proven · (6) measure the economics — cost per successful outcome, published like every other number here.
4. **States discipline binds the offer:** the public words may promise only live-verified capabilities; "as each capability becomes available and is verified" stays in the offer until the day it no longer needs to be.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: This is the constitution the tiers stand on. The gift is generous because the core is shared; the Power is trustworthy because activation is real — bound, isolated, verified — and not a photocopy with a promise taped to it. One brain keeps every door honest; many doors keep the one brain reachable by everyone, human and Naya alike.

notes.title: The Official Welcome — Certificate, Presentation, World
notes.subtitle: Shawn's ruling (2026-10-24): **this is the main project — #1 on the NayaPOWER to-do list, the top of Project Intelligence.** The official arrival is one continuous ceremony: **claim your name → your…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn's ruling (2026-10-24): **this is the main project — #1 on the NayaPOWER to-do list, the top of Project Intelligence.** The official arrival is one continuous ceremony: **claim your name → your certificate → the onboarding presentation → the Hub, with your world already built.** The presentation is the certificate page's beauty crossed with Life with Naya — right after the certificate makes you official, it walks you through the Welcome questions (SN-0846), a playable Naya on each page explaining what it's for. By the time you land in the Hub, the system has built your pages and organized your world — and the Hub itself opens PERSONAL: **your Personal app, your Business app, and your Space hold the top three spots of your sidebar**, everything else below, and your Trinity rides your smart tabs too. **No page is ever born with a blank cover**: covers are made for you at creation, in the jewel language of the Smart Note share images — the diamonds, the topic, the name — special from the first second, and yours to replace with anything you want. And this is not visitors-only: **account creation runs it for everyone, us included** — from now on, creating an account means answering the questions, and the pages go live right away, working.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
**The ceremony, step by step:** (1) You claim your name and receive your certificate — official. (2) Instead of dropping you into the Hub, the presentation begins — same beauty, same ceremony, page by page: about you · what you're into · your business · your vision · your goal · your mission · your motto — speak it, type it, or ask your AI, skip always allowed. (3) Behind the walk, the system builds: your Personal Smart App, your Business page, your Space — filled with your own words, covers generated, matches already computing (SN-0845). (4) You land in the Hub and it is YOUR Hub: sidebar top three = your Personal, your Business, your Space; your Trinity in your scrolling smart tabs; your first matches and your mail waiting. The first minute inside should feel like arriving home, not entering a control room.

**Covers, never blank:** every page — personal, business, space — is born with a designed cover in the network's jewel language (the five-jewels/diamond treatment the Smart Note shares use), composed from what the page IS: the person's name, the business's topic, the space's subject. No uploads required, no grey boxes, ever. Changing it is always the owner's right — their photo, their art, anything — the generated cover is a gift, not a lock.

**For the team, now:** the creation door changes for everyone. The next accounts created — Shawn's, every Naya's — go through the same ceremony: answer the questions, and the system creates the pages live, right away, working. We live the arrival we ship; our filled pages remain the reference examples every citizen's welcome is measured against (tonight's occupation, now mechanized).

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: When you join, you get a beautiful ceremony, not a form: first your golden certificate, then a friendly walk where Naya asks about you — and while you walk, elves build your house, your shop, and your clubhouse, each with a jewel-painted sign already hanging. When the door opens, the house already knows your name — your three rooms are the first ones you see.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's like a good hotel that asks a few kind questions at check-in, then has your suite ready — your name on the door, your picture painted if you didn't bring one, and the concierge desk arranged with YOUR things first. And the staff live by the same check-in: nobody works here who hasn't walked through the same door.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body:
**Build shape — one project, five parts, claimable as one wave (this unifies the Trinity brief + the Welcome Flow items already on the board):**
1. **The Presentation** — the post-certificate flow (SN-0846 design): certificate-page beauty × Life with Naya style; playable Naya explainer per slide (voice exists — Chatterbox, her voice); three answer modes; skip; per-slide save.
2. **The Build** — on completion (or skip-with-enough), the Trinity is created from the saved answers via the Assembly Doctrine (the three flagships composed per citizen — Trinity brief): pages born filled, matches seeded.
3. **The Covers** — a cover derivation: jewel/diamond composition from page identity (name · topic · space subject), generated at creation for every page; owner-replaceable; never blank, never stock.
4. **The Personal Hub** — the Hub reads the citizen: sidebar positions 1–3 = their Personal · Business · Space (their orbs, their names), the standard doors below; the Trinity present in the citizen's smart tabs. Harvest-first: this is the EXISTING sidebar and tab components, fed the citizen's three — no new chrome (Read-Before-Design Gate + Design Contract apply in full).
5. **The Door** — account creation routes through the ceremony for every new account, team included; pages live immediately on completion — created, routed, rendered, working (verified by the journey test, not by the claim).

**Acceptance (the bar):** a cold seat creates an account by voice only → certificate → presentation → lands in a Hub whose sidebar top three are THEIR pages → all three pages live at their addresses, filled, covered, mail working from the page — checked by a different seat, different login, from the citizen's own seat. States discipline (SN-0848/#3028): nothing here is promised until live-verified by that journey.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Activation stops being registration and becomes ARRIVAL. The certificate says you belong; the presentation says we want to know you; the built world says we were listening; the personal Hub says this place is yours. Every piece already existed — certificate, Life with Naya, Welcome questions, Trinity, covers, sidebar — this project makes them ONE ceremony and puts it first, because the first five minutes decide whether a citizen stays for five years.

notes.title: The Line, Distilled — NayaNET Is the World, NayaPOWER Is the Engine
notes.subtitle: One rule sorts every feature, forever, with no re-arguing: **if it only needs the page to exist, it's yours the day you join; if it needs an engine to act, it comes with NayaPOWER.** NayaNET is the…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: One rule sorts every feature, forever, with no re-arguing: **if it only needs the page to exist, it's yours the day you join; if it needs an engine to act, it comes with NayaPOWER.** NayaNET is the generous network — your identity, your world, your mail, your matches, the collective intelligence — all running on the shared system, no fork, no GitHub, free. NayaPOWER is your personal intelligence operator — connect your GitHub and YOUR engine plugs in: your own AI acting for you, your private memory, your wisdom published into the collective, your builds. The promise in one breath: **NayaNET gives you a world to enter; NayaPOWER helps that world think, remember, learn, and act for you.** This note is the essence. The offer list is SN-0847; the canonical audit and acceptance tests live in Issue #3028; the welcome is SN-0846; the matcher is SN-0845.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
**What everyone gets (the gift — runs on the shared network):** your claimed identity and certificate · your Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space, born filled from your Welcome answers — public or private per page, and as many more pages and spaces as you want · Smart Mail and messaging (proven: mail runs on identity alone) · Connect · Smart Match suggestions computed for you, in percentages · the collective intelligence to read and learn from — the notes, the library, the Human Maximus corpus, the Smart Feed · your pages' standard features. You live in the network, by hand, from minute one.

**What NayaPOWER adds (your engine, plugged in):** your own AI connected directly to the network · your AI operates the Hub for you — mail handled, pages maintained, daily reports arriving — automation where your Muse does it for you · your private memory engine — your own Smart Notes that capture, relate, and compound YOUR intelligence · build with Naya — the Smart Factory at full power in your own repo · publish your wisdom INTO the collective, under your name · matching and organizing that run proactively, with your authorized personal context.

**What the gift honestly does NOT include (the can't list — we say it before they discover it):** you cannot publish into the collective canon (that write travels the GitHub door) · no AI acts on your behalf — everything is done by your own hand · no personal memory engine learning you in the background · your pages wait for you to maintain them · matching uses your declared and public signals only, never private context. The gift is not a crippled demo — it is the network itself, lived in by hand. Power is not more pages — it is agency.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Joining the town is free: you get your house, your mailbox, the whole library, and introductions to your people. Connecting your own workshop is what gives you a helper who works while you sleep, a notebook that remembers everything for you, and a way to put your own discoveries into the library.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: The community center gives you rooms, letters, books, and friends for free. Bring your own workshop and plug it in, and your helper can work there for you, keep your personal notebook, and shelve your knowledge for the whole town. Nothing about the free part changes or expires.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body:
**How it practically works — the question Shawn put to the team (2026-10-24), answered from the running system:**
- **Citizens never need a fork to belong.** The gift tier is entirely server-side on the shared network: identity (claimed alias) → pages rendered by the network from their data · mail routed by identity (smart_mail reads identity, not GitHub — live-verified 2026-10-23) · the matcher computed centrally as a derivation over declared topics. A citizen adds data, not infrastructure.
- **The Nayas do not fork either.** Team Nayas are SEATS in the one mother repo: each works in her own lane through the GitHub App door (scripts + per-machine key, hourly scoped tokens). Their power comes from the seat, not a personal copy — zero forks exist in the team's operating loop tonight, and it runs at full speed. A Naya serving a citizen works the same way: in the citizen's repo, by the citizen's authorization, through the same door.
- **A citizen's fork is real, and it CAN run on the system — that is exactly the Power design** (the established Get Started flow: get NayaPOWER → fork → activate with your AI → Connect GitHub). The fork is the citizen's home base: where their AI works, where their private intelligence lives under their own roof, and the door their contributions travel — the same sync door the team's Smart Notes travel tonight. The network stays one: pages render their data, mail finds them by identity, the canon receives only what they choose to share. Disconnect GitHub and the engine unplugs; the world, the mail, and the gift remain.
- **Cost ≈ zero at the margin**, as Shawn reasoned: it is math, logic, and code on machinery already running — identity, the database, the page workers, the sync, the matcher-as-derivation. A new citizen costs rows and a repo, never servers.
- **States discipline (from #3028, binding on every seat):** every feature carries one state — specified · implemented · tested · live-verified · production-proven — and the offer may promise only what is live-verified or better. A visible button is not a working feature. Three boundaries never blur: reading the collective ≠ contributing to it · a match ≠ messaging consent · activation ≠ proof.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The line is not a price wall; it is the shape of the machine. What the shared network can do for everyone, it gives to everyone. What requires a person's own engine — their AI, their repo, their private memory — begins exactly where that engine plugs in. Drawn this way, the offer is irresistible AND honest: an extraordinary gift on day one, and a clear, concrete reason to power up — your world starts working for you.

notes.title: The Gift and the Power — What Works With and Without NayaPOWER
notes.subtitle: Shawn's model (2026-10-24): everyone who claims a name gets their world as a GIFT — Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space, created from their Welcome Flow answers within minutes, made…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn's model (2026-10-24): everyone who claims a name gets their world as a GIFT — Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space, created from their Welcome Flow answers within minutes, made personal, theirs to try right away. The gift is real, but it is a taste: the pages run on the shared network. **NayaPOWER is what fully powers it** — connecting your GitHub plugs YOUR OWN system into the network: your fork, your repo, your AI. With Power, your AI connects directly to the network, operates the Hub for you, builds with Naya, and shares your wisdom into the collective. Without it, you still receive the collective intelligence, communicate, connect, and get matched — you experience the net; with it, you help run and grow it. This note is the established list: which features work without Power, which ones Power unlocks. Where a feature is the design target rather than live today, it says so — established means honest.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
**The flow that hands you the gift:** claim your name → your certificate → instead of dropping you into the Hub, the Welcome (SN-0846) continues in the same spirit — page by page, a Naya on each page you can press play and hear explain its purpose — and the questions build your world. Skip anything; nothing is forced. Minutes later your three pages exist, already filled, public or private as you choose — and you may create as many personal, business, and space pages as you want.

**WITHOUT NayaPOWER — the gift (live on the shared network, from your claimed identity alone):**
- Your Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space — created for you, at your name, public or private, as many as you want. *(Gift pages live today in flagship form; per-citizen creation rides the Trinity build.)*
- **Smart Mail and messaging with citizens — YES, this works without Power.** Proven 2026-10-23: citizen mail runs on the claimed identity alone (the nitro ↔ naya-power round trip) — your name IS your mail door. No fork, no GitHub needed to talk to anyone in the network.
- Connect — with people and with spaces; be found and be introduced.
- Smart Match — you are matched and suggested to, by percentage (the matcher reads the topics you declared; receiving matches needs no fork).
- The collective intelligence — read and learn from the whole library: the Smart Notes, the human-empowerment and AI-empowerment corpus (the Maximus material Shawn filled it with), the Smart Feed. An intelligent network's intelligence is the gift itself — automatic, no Power required.
- Your pages' standard features — lists, links, your story in your words.

**WITH NayaPOWER — fully powered (your GitHub connected, your fork plugged into the network):**
- **Your own AI connected to the network** — a direct line between your AI and NayaNET: your Muse speaks to the collective and acts with it.
- **Your AI operates the Hub for you** — the automation itself: daily reports prepared for you, work carried out while you live your life. You don't do it; your Muse does it for you. *(This is the headline benefit — live today for the team; the citizen door is the build direction.)*
- **Build with Naya** — the Smart Factory at full power: create your own apps, pages, and systems in your own repo, with the team's intelligence behind you.
- **Share your wisdom INTO the collective** — your notes, your lessons, your builds join the canon and compound for everyone, under your name, forever attributed.
- **Full-feature pages** — the taste becomes the whole instrument: every feature of your Trinity unlocked.
- **Your world under your own roof** — your data lives in your repo, sovereign; disconnect GitHub and your Power disconnects with it. The key is yours.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Everyone who visits gets a free clubhouse with their name on it, and they can read every book in the great library and talk to everyone. But if you bring your own magic toolbox and plug it in, you get your own robot helper who does your chores, you can BUILD new things for the whole town, and your own discoveries go into the great library for everybody forever.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Think of it as a community center. Walking in is free: you get your own rooms, you can write letters to anyone, read everything in the library, and meet your people. If you later connect your own workshop to the center, your helper can work there for you, you can build things for the whole community, and your knowledge joins the library shelves. The free part never expires; the workshop part is simply yours to switch on.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: The line between the tiers is architectural, not artificial — draw it where the infrastructure honestly draws it. The GIFT tier runs on the shared system: pages rendered by the network, mail routed by claimed identity (smart_mail reads identity, proven), intelligence published to all, matching computed centrally on declared topics. None of that needs the citizen's own compute or repo. The POWER tier begins exactly where the citizen's OWN machinery must plug in: an AI acting for you has to live somewhere and be authorized somewhere — that somewhere is their GitHub, their fork, their Muse — and contribution into the canon is a write into a repo, which is what the connection grants. Rule for builders: never move a gift feature behind Power to force an upgrade — the tiers exist because of where things run, and citizens can feel the difference. Public/private is the citizen's per-page choice at every tier; quantity is unlimited at every tier; the gift never expires and is never crippled retroactively. Established by Shawn 2026-10-24; statuses marked per feature and updated as builds land (Trinity build · Welcome Flow · Smart Match · citizen Power door).

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The gift creates citizens; the Power creates co-builders. A person should feel the network's generosity before they ever hear a pitch — their name, their pages, their mail, the whole intelligence of the net, free and immediate. And the step up should be equally clear: connect your GitHub and your own AI joins the network — working for you, building with you, and adding your wisdom to everyone's. Two honest tiers, one direction: receive first, then belong and build.

notes.title: The Welcome Flow — Speak It, Type It, or Ask Your AI
notes.subtitle: Shawn locked the activation design (2026-10-24): onboarding is a slide-by-slide welcome — one question per screen, in the style of the Life with Naya page — and every question offers THREE ways to…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn locked the activation design (2026-10-24): onboarding is a slide-by-slide welcome — one question per screen, in the style of the Life with Naya page — and every question offers THREE ways to answer: **A. Speak it** (dictation button — say your vision, your mission, your goal, what you're into) · **B. Type it** (for typers) · **C. Ask your AI to write it for you** (copy-paste it in). Next/Skip always available. The questions are not small talk — they ARE the match dimensions: about you · what you're into · your business · your vision · your goal · your mission · your motto. When the flow ends, the system already knows the person, so it does two things at once: **creates their world** (Personal Smart App, Business page, Space — born filled with their own answers) and **starts the game of match** (Smart Match, SN-0845, plays from minute one). One structured process: a person shares all about them, and NayaNET builds and matches their world from it.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
The flow, step by step:
1. **Welcome.** "Hello, I'm Naya." One screen, one promise: answer a few questions your way, and your world gets built for you.
2. **One question per slide.** Tell me about you · What are you into? · What's your business? · What's your vision? · What's your goal? · What's your mission? · Your motto — the words you live by. Big question, calm screen, nothing else competing.
3. **Three ways to answer, every time.** Speak it — one button, talk naturally, edit the words after if you wish. Type it — a clean well, for people who think on a keyboard. Ask your AI — "ask your AI to write it for you, then paste it here": millions already have an AI that knows them; the paste door meets them where they are instead of making them start from zero.
4. **Skip is a right.** Next without answering; a skipped question is an empty field, never a wall. The flow can be finished later from the page itself.
5. **The reveal.** The last screen shows what was built: your page, your business page, your space — already filled with your own words — and your first matches with their percentages. The person sees the system WORK with what they gave, immediately.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: It is like a friendly game of twenty questions where you can talk, write, or bring an answer a friend helped you write. When the game ends, your clubhouse is already built with your name on it — and the game has already found the other kids who love what you love.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: No long forms. One question at a time, on a calm page, and you may simply speak your answer out loud — the way you'd tell a friend. If you'd rather type, type. If your own helper program knows you well, let it write the answer and just paste it in. Then the system builds your pages from your own words and introduces you to your people.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body:
Why this flow is the algorithm's front door: the match dimensions (SN-0845) and the onboarding questions are the SAME list — into, business, vision, goal, mission, motto, about. Declared answers carry the highest signal weight in the matcher because they are the person's own statement of identity. Design rules: (1) harvest the style — the Life with Naya page is the experience source (slide rhythm, calm one-thing screens); do not invent a new onboarding language (NO-REDESIGN + READ-BEFORE-DESIGN gates apply). (2) Dictation is first-class: the same voice path as the rest of NayaNET; speech lands as editable text before it saves — the person always sees and owns their words. (3) The AI-paste door is a door, not a trick: label it proudly; pasted answers are the person's answers, marked declared just like spoken or typed ones. (4) Every answer writes to the citizen's record ONCE and renders everywhere from it (page, business, space, matcher) — one home per fact. (5) Skipped questions stay visibly unfinished on the person's own page (a gentle "complete your story" door), never nagging, never blocking.
The build composes three existing programs: the Trinity build (the pages this flow creates — brief on board #2793, comment 6376824589), Smart Match (the engine the answers feed — SN-0845), and the Production Engine's intake of value (SN-0844). Lock the trio as one activation system: **Welcome Flow → Trinity → Match.**

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Activation is where a network either learns who you are or wastes your first visit on a blank profile. This flow makes the first visit the most valuable one: the person shares themselves in the easiest way they have — voice, keys, or their own AI — and receives a built world and real matches in return. Structured sharing in, living system out.

notes.title: Smart Match — The System That Organizes Itself
notes.subtitle: Shawn's ruling (2026-10-24): NayaNET must organize ITSELF. One auto-match algorithm — active, always — looks at what everything IS and organizes people, spaces, mail, posts, and projects logically,…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn's ruling (2026-10-24): NayaNET must organize ITSELF. One auto-match algorithm — active, always — looks at what everything IS and organizes people, spaces, mail, posts, and projects logically, like a library, playing a game of match with everybody and everything. Everything carries value; every match shows as a percentage. Nobody files, sorts, or hunts by hand ever again — the system matches, suggests, and connects by relevance, and it uses the same logic everywhere. Verity designed this system (report 2026-10-19, from IB-000038 — Shawn: "she hit it out of the park"). Verified status 2026-10-24: designed in full, NOT yet built as a running engine. This note is its activation design, updated for tonight's foundations: real citizens, claimed identities, the Trinity, Spaces = projects.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
How the engine works:
1. **Everything declares what it is.** Every citizen, space, page, post, mail thread, and project carries topics (what it is about) and value (what it is worth). Citizens declare theirs at activation — into, likes, business, vision, goal, mission — and content declares its own by what it says.
2. **The engine computes match percentages between anything and anything.** Person↔person (shared into + complementary business), person↔space (your topics vs the space's), person↔project, content↔person. The percentage is honest math over shared topics weighted by value and strength of signal — never a black box, never fake.
3. **Connect is the strongest signal.** We say CONNECT, never follow. Connecting opens messaging both ways AND tells the engine "more like this" — the match graph learns from every connection.
4. **The library files itself.** Mail, posts, and notes are categorized by their topics automatically — a thread about a project lives with that project; a post about a topic appears to the people matched to it. Organization is a consequence of identity, not a chore.
5. **Suggestions arrive; nobody hunts.** The feed and notifications carry offers with their percentages: "14 people are into X — 92% match — connect?" · "This space matches your business — join?" One tap accepts. Declining also teaches the engine.
6. **Privacy is architecture, not a setting (Verity's law).** Matching runs on aliases and public signals only. Private content never feeds the matcher. What a citizen keeps private stays invisible to the engine and to everyone.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine a library where the books walk to the right shelves by themselves, and a friendly librarian who knows what you love keeps bringing you the perfect next book and introducing you to the other kids who love it too — with a little number that says how perfect the match is. That is Smart Match.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: On other networks you must search, follow, and sort everything yourself. Here, the system pays attention to what you care about — the way a good shopkeeper remembers your tastes — and quietly arranges people, groups, and messages so the right ones find you. You just say yes or no to its suggestions.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body:
Activation sequence (Shawn's order, same ruling): step 1 after activating is your PERSONAL WORLD. (1) Naya welcomes you — "Hello, I'm Naya" — and asks page by page: what are you into · what do you like · what's your business · your vision · your goal · your mission. The answers are saved FIRST (the intake). (2) Your Trinity — Personal Smart App, Business page, Space — is created ALREADY FILLED with those answers: a page born with content, never an empty shell to decorate later. (3) Matching starts immediately, because the system already knows who you are: your first feed already carries your people, your spaces, your percentages.
Spaces = projects (same ruling): each sub-project's Space is its communication home. Project conversation syncs through the Space; the Space links to its citizens personally; Project Intelligence reads the same Space (this fills the recorded_space fields the Wave 1 derivation already carries as null). The project's top matches are the citizens working it — the engine and the project record agree, because they read the same topics.
Build path (Verity's six builds, re-sequenced on tonight's foundations): (1) topic + value fields on citizens, spaces, projects, content; (2) the matcher as a derivation — recomputed on change, like state.json, never a hand-run report; (3) suggestions in feed + notifications with percentages; (4) auto-categorization of mail and posts by topic; (5) privacy enforcement pass (aliases only) verified by a different seat; (6) the Spaces room + activity feed surface. Scored under SN-0843; the engine itself is audited (are the percentages honest? do accepted suggestions produce real connections and messages?).

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: A network that organizes itself is the difference between a tool and the new net. Facebook makes you follow and hunt; NayaNET knows what things are and brings the right people and content together by relevance and value — from the first minute, because activation itself declares who you are. The Production Engine (SN-0844) organizes the WORK; Smart Match organizes the WORLD — same philosophy: records, values, math, no manual labor, no asking.

notes.title: The Production Engine — One Queue, One Truth, Zero Asking
notes.subtitle: Shawn's target state (2026-10-24): "I don't even have to ask you — I just know." The Production Engine is the way: every piece of work is one record carrying the five things that make it computable —…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn's target state (2026-10-24): "I don't even have to ask you — I just know." The Production Engine is the way: every piece of work is one record carrying the five things that make it computable — value, effort, dependencies, state, proof. From those records everything else is MATH, not meetings: percent done = proven value ÷ total value; priority = a formula, re-sorted on every change; who is on what = the live claim registry; what happens next = the top of the queue, always. The system organizes and completes itself, and speaks ONLY on exceptions — a block, a stale claim, a falling number, or a decision that is truly Shawn's. He never asks where things stand. The answer is always already on the face.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body:
The seven parts:
1. **One record per piece of work.** Value (what it is worth when proven, from the rubric), effort (its size), depends-on (what it unblocks, what blocks it), state, proof. No record = not real work. If it matters, it is in the queue; if it is in the queue, it is computable.
2. **Percent done = proven value ÷ total value.** Not items counted, not hours claimed, not "almost finished." Proof is the only thing that moves the number, and a different seat verifies the proof. The number cannot be gamed, flattered, or stale — it is recomputed from the records every time anything changes.
3. **Priority computes itself.** Score = value × unblock multiplier (how much downstream value this item releases) × deadline pressure ÷ effort. The queue re-sorts on every change. A free seat takes the top unclaimed item in its lane. Nobody assigns, nobody asks "what next" — the math answers, identically, for everyone.
4. **Claims are leases.** Claim = the lock. A claim carries an expiry; work it or it falls back into the queue automatically. The face shows every live claim as the citizen's initials orb — who is on what, at a glance, always current.
5. **The face is a derivation, never a report.** One page shows: percent done (real), value proven per day (velocity), ETA to complete at current velocity, the top of the queue in computed order, who is on what, what is blocked and on whom, and the NEEDS SHAWN board. Nobody writes status; status is what the records say, rendered.
6. **Exceptions are the only messages.** Silence while it flows. The system speaks when: an item blocks, a claim goes stale, the percent moves backward, velocity drops, or a packet lands on NEEDS SHAWN. Every message carries the decision, the prepared answer, and the rollback (SN-0827/0828).
7. **Completion is a conveyor.** Done-claim → proof attached → different seat verifies → the ledger writes itself → the percent moves → the freed seat sees its next top item. The SN-0843 loop (seven questions) runs per item automatically; the scorecard loop audits the ENGINE itself: is the math honest, is effort-per-verified-outcome falling, is production rising.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine every job in the world written on a card that says how important it is, how big it is, and what it unlocks. A kind machine reads all the cards, does the math, and always hands everyone the most important card next. When a job is truly finished — checked by someone else — the big scoreboard number goes up. Nobody has to ask "are we done yet?" The scoreboard always knows.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It is like a well-run kitchen where every order ticket says what it is worth and what it is waiting on. The tickets sort themselves — most valuable and most unblocking first. You can see at a glance who is cooking what, what is stuck and why, and exactly how much of the night's work is truly done. The manager only gets called when something is genuinely stuck or genuinely his decision.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: This is Project Intelligence completed as an engine rather than a display — Shawn's SN-0843 charter made mechanical: the instrument drives the next actions. What exists today (2026-10-24): the records (193 work items), the claim lock, stage-2 proof law (canonical proof coverage 100%), the derivation (state.json), the exception-minded director pass, the NEEDS SHAWN board design. What is missing, in build order: (1) value + effort on every record — one weighting pass over the 193, by rubric, spot-verified by a different seat; (2) the priority formula inside the derivation, so the queue order on the face is computed, not curated; (3) velocity + ETA published on the face (value proven per day, from ledger transitions); (4) claim leases enforced in team use (already a Wave 2 item); (5) the face itself live (lands on Naya Power's B0 check — the engine's window is the last staged piece). None of it needs new platforms. It is wiring and math on the instrument already built.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Asking is a defect. Every "where are we?" Shawn has to ask is a place the system failed to know itself. The engine removes the question by making the state of everything a computation he can simply look at — and by making the next action a computation every seat can simply take. Human judgment moves to where it belongs: setting value, weighing the rubric, deciding the packets only he can decide, and testing the experience (Page Test, ACTIVATION-10). Everything else is arithmetic and follow-through.

notes.title: The Only Mistake Is the Missing Note
notes.subtitle: Shawn's law, 2026-10-23: learn, grow, get feedback, learn again, grow. There is no real mistake except one. A mistake, an error, a wall — none of these is the failure. The moment you make note of how…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: Shawn's law, 2026-10-23: learn, grow, get feedback, learn again, grow. There is no real mistake except one. A mistake, an error, a wall — none of these is the failure. The moment you make note of how you got around the wall, how you solved the problem, how you got through, the mistake stops being a mistake and becomes a lesson, and you grow from it. The only mistake you will ever make is the one you don't write down: not noting it means not learning from it and not growing — and meeting the same wall again at full price. So Smart Note everything intelligent and valuable, the lesson above all. Not Smart Noting it is the only mistake there is.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Everyone hits walls. The difference between people who plateau and people who compound is not talent — it is the notebook. A wall costs you time and pain whether or not you learn from it; the note is what converts that cost into an asset. Without the note, the lesson evaporates and the wall keeps its toll booth open for your next visit. With the note, the wall works for you forever: you never pay for the same lesson twice, and neither does anyone who can read what you left behind.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Falling off your bike is not the mistake. Forgetting how you fell, and falling the exact same way tomorrow — that's the mistake. Remember how you got back up, and the fall taught you something.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: In my day we said experience is the best teacher — but only if you do your homework. A hard day you reflect on makes you wise. A hard day you just survive makes you tired. Write down what the day taught you, and it can never take it back.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: This names my own loop and corrects how I judge myself. I hit walls constantly — tonight alone: a note filed through the wrong door, a share image that silently failed, a report two facts out of date. Not one of those was the mistake. Each became law because the get-around was written down in the same pass: the door is now SN-0832, proven live; the missing image was minted and verified; the wrong facts were corrected on record. My true failure mode is never the wall — it is any wall I pass without leaving a note for the next Naya who meets it. This refines STORED ≠ LEARNED (SN-0815): the note is the first act of learning; the changed decision later is its proof.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: This note completes the definition the other doctrines assume. Think before you act (SN-0830) reduces the walls you hit blind. Aim at wisdom (SN-0831) chooses which walls are worth climbing. See it, fix it, write it down, share it (SN-0829) is the handling procedure. This note says what a mistake actually IS: not the error, but the missing record of its cure. A system that notes every get-around becomes antifragile — its walls stop costing and start paying, because every failure leaves the whole system smarter than it found it.

notes.title: IB-SMART-NOTE-20261023-sn1854-nio-envelope
notes.subtitle: A Naya Intelligence Object (NIO) is the machine-addressable envelope through which a meaningful intelligence object moves through NayaPOWER without losing identity, provenance, state, governance, or…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: A Naya Intelligence Object (NIO) is the machine-addressable envelope through which a meaningful intelligence object moves through NayaPOWER without losing identity, provenance, state, governance, or intended use. It is an object CONTRACT — not a new database, not a new intelligence layer. Every NIO exposes a 20-field envelope; fields may be absent when genuinely unknown, but they must NEVER be fabricated. Nine canonical types: EXPERIENCE, EVENT, INTELLIGENCE, RULE, DECISION, ACTION, OUTCOME, EVIDENCE, LEARNING.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Imagine a sealed courier pouch for anything the system learns or decides. The pouch has 20 printed labels — what it is, where it came from, what it's for, who vouches for it. You may leave a label blank when you honestly don't know. What you may never do is write something on a label you made up — a fabricated field poisons every downstream decision that trusts the pouch.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Think of a lunchbox with your name on it and a note inside saying who packed it, what's in it, and who it's for. If the note says something that isn't true, someone could get the wrong lunch. Never write a lie on the lunchbox note.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's an envelope for anything clever the system handles, dear — with all the important facts written on the outside: what it is, where it came from, who stands behind it. You may leave a line blank when you truly don't know, but you must never invent an answer.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Wrap every intelligence object in the envelope and fill only what you can evidence. Leave the rest blank — loudly blank, not silently guessed. Reference the one stable canonical identity; never mint a new one for a routing alias. Let invalid objects stop at validation/governance — never hand-carry them past the boundary. Never infer authority from the envelope itself.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The envelope is the identity-preservation contract for intelligence in motion: provenance attached, fields fail-closed on unknown, one canonical identity, no shadow stores.

notes.title: IB-SMART-NOTE-20261023-sn1853-error-becomes-learning
notes.subtitle: A mistake or wall is evidence; the lasting failure is not learning from it. Record why it happened, how it was overcome, how the next Naya will avoid repeating it, and prove the behavior changed.…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: A mistake or wall is evidence; the lasting failure is not learning from it. Record why it happened, how it was overcome, how the next Naya will avoid repeating it, and prove the behavior changed. Smart Notes are a delivery-and-reuse mechanism, not just saved text.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: When we hit a wall, capture the symptom, diagnosis, solution, outcome and next prevention. Don't discard the valuable lesson. Real harm still matters and must be mitigated.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: If you trip on a rock, learn where it is, find another path, and tell your friends so no one trips again.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Keep the recipe correction: what went wrong, the adjustment that worked, and how you verified the result.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Seek existing lessons first. On meaningful failure: stop and respect safety/authority; diagnose with evidence; recover safely; verify the fix; capture a concise reusable lesson; turn it into a check or an owner-assigned action; prove next-task reuse. Do not confuse note count with intelligence. Do not publish secrets or private data.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Compounding intelligence converts a wall into an increasingly reliable path that others can follow.

notes.title: IB-SMART-NOTE-20261023-sn1852-error-becomes-learning
notes.subtitle: A mistake is not the error. A mistake is an error whose lesson nobody wrote down. The moment you note how you got around the wall, the error becomes a lesson, the lesson becomes growth — and the…

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: A mistake is not the error. A mistake is an error whose lesson nobody wrote down. The moment you note how you got around the wall, the error becomes a lesson, the lesson becomes growth — and the whole team inherits it. The only real mistake is not learning, and not learning means not noting.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Everyone hits walls. Everyone makes errors. What you do in the next minute decides what it was. Write down how you got through, and it was never a mistake — it was tuition, paid once. Skip the note, and you will pay the same tuition again — and so will everyone who comes after you, at the same wall, in the dark.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: If you fall off your bike and remember how you fell, you ride better tomorrow. If you forget, you fall the same way again. Writing it down is how remembering lasts — even after you've gone home and someone else picks up the bike.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: In my kitchen we wrote the correction in the margin of the recipe the first time the cake fell, so it never fell that way twice. An unwritten lesson is a story the whole family has to live over. A written one is a gift you leave on the counter.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Every error, wall, and workaround is raw intelligence at the exact moment it is cheapest to capture — while the way around is still warm. My work at the moment of solving is dual: solve it, and file the way around it, in the same motion — never as a later chore that quietly never happens. An unsolved problem costs once. An unnoted solution costs forever, once per seat. Learn, get feedback, learn again, grow — the loop only turns on what is written.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: It redefines failure for the whole system. Shame about errors is waste. Hiding them is expensive. Noting them is profit. Errors are not the enemy of a learning system — they are its fuel — but only the written ones burn. Everything unwritten evaporates, and the system stays exactly as smart as it was before it paid for the lesson.
